tonight.headline: The Ravens claim did not land — add the Patriots now
body: Bad news first: Bok-aneers took the Ravens' defence at 01:54 and Footballers the Chiefs'. Your only defence is still the Vikings, on bye, worth 0.0 — and ESPN's 67% is computed with that zero in it.

The fix no longer needs a claim. The Patriots' defence is a free agent (7.7, the best on your wire): add it now, dropping the Vikings. Everything else is set — the lineup as set is the projection lineup — and Coker's first official practice report comes this afternoon.

case.label: Why now, not Sunday
case.body: A free agent goes to whoever clicks first. Jets 7.3 and Giants 7.1 are the next two if the Patriots go; the Jaguars are on waivers until Thursday 01:00 and project lower.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Coker inactive at 09:30 Sunday — Kamara takes the flex. Or the Patriots added by someone else before you: take the Jets.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Free agent now · no claim needed · must be done before Sun 11:00 Mexico City, sooner is safer
doFirst.title: Add the Patriots' defence; drop the Vikings'
doFirst.subtitle: The Ravens claim was beaten. The Patriots are free, the best defence on your wire, and Minnesota are still on bye.

case.label: The hole
case.body: Vikings D/ST is your only defence and Minnesota are off in Week 6: 0.0 in a slot the wire fills for 7-8.

case.label: The pick
case.body: Patriots 7.7, Jets 7.3, Giants 7.1 among free agents in this league's projection. FantasyPros ranks New England 2nd overall this week: Geno Smith has taken at least three sacks in each of his last four games (13 Oct). Covers has New England -7.5 at home with a total of 43.5 and the Jets 26th in total yards.

case.label: The drop
case.body: The Vikings are 81% rostered, so this disagrees with the market on the record: a defence on bye scores nothing, defences are streamed by policy, and every skill player on the bench is either a fallback or exposure-protected.

case.label: The other side
case.body: The same game is the Jets defence's best case too — Maye at home — and FantasyPros has them only 12th. The 0.4 gap is a coin flip, so the projection decides.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The Patriots score less in Week 6 than the Jets or the Giants defences, the two free alternatives today (archive).

action.label: Add Patriots D/ST · drop Vikings D/ST

whatWentWrong.title: The Ravens claim did not land
whatWentWrong.lead: Bok-aneers took Baltimore at 07:54 UTC and Footballers the Chiefs. You are still 2nd in the order, which suggests your claim was never placed.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Waivers process in order and every team that won a claim fell to the bottom (Bok-aneers 10th, Footballers 9th, Talla Metralla 8th). AVIATO sit 2nd, unchanged — a team ahead of Bok-aneers that had claimed the Ravens would have got them. ESPN does not show failed claims, so this is an inference.

case.label: The cost
case.body: About half a point: Ravens 8.2 against the Patriots 7.7 now available free. The real cost would be letting the bye stand — that is the card above.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: If the claim was placed and lost to a reordering, the lesson is different: name a free-agent fallback on every claim card. This brief now does.
